newsitem.title: USA: Sinter Metals says unit sells joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Sinter Metals says unit sells joint venture.

text.p: Sinter Metals Inc said Tuesday its Sinter Metals GmbH subsidiary has sold its 50 percent interest in PEAK Werkstoff GmbH to its joint venture partner, Erbsloh Aluminum AG.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
Sinter Metals GmbH and Erbsloh Aluminum AG formed the joint venture in 1988 to develop market pressed powder metal aluminum alloys.
The company also said today it has postponed indefinitely its annual meeting as a result of the recently announced tender offer for all of its outstanding class A and B common stock by GKN plc.
The tender offer at $37 per share was announced May 1 following a merger agreement on April 30 in which GKN will acquire Sinter Metals.
